Name: More Vanilla Rugs
Author: pheauxm
Description:
Adds 40+ rugs that are otherwise only seen in villager houses, festivals, etc, along with a config to hide them from the Furniture Catalogue if you'd like to shorten the list. They appear in the catalogue by default.

A full list of the rugs added and their normal location:
[spoiler]
Long Hallway Rug; Mullners' house
Hallway Rug; a shorter version of the above
Bear Skin Rug; Adventurer's Guild
Dark Green Cottage Rug; Saloon, Shane's room, Museum, Community Center, Adventurer's Guild Bedroom
Green Health Rug; Desert Festival
Dream Rug; Emily's 2-heart event
Purple/Red/Yellow Fair Rug; Stardew Valley Fair festival
Giant Rug; Pierre's living room
Gold Rug; Mullners' house, Carpenter's, Pam's upgraded room
Gray Cottage Rug; Jodi's house, Wizard's Tower, Community Center, Penny's upgraded room
Gray Rug; (I can't find this one again in-game)
Long Gray Cottage Rug; Emily and Haley's house, Saloon, Abigail's room, Museum
Large Grey Rug; Community Center Vault
Large Yellow Rug; Robin and Demetrius's room
Rancher's Mat; Marnie's
Coffee Rug and Blue/Orange/Pink/Green Night Market Rugs; Night Market
Oval Mat; (also cannot find this again)
Yellow Pear Rug; Dyeing area in Emily and Haley's house
Picnic Blanket(s); variations of Penny's picnic blanket from her 8-heart event
Red/Summer Shop Mat; in front of Pierre's shop
Pink Cottage Rug; Haley's room
Blue/Green/Red Mining Rug; Qi's event when you reach the 100th level of Skull Cavern
Red Desert Rug; Desert Festival
Red Mat; Lewis's home
Red Modern Rug; Lewis's home, Pam's upgraded house
Red Old World Rug; Emily and Haley's house, Jodi's room
Red Oval Mat; Adventurer's Guild, Saloon
Red Patterned Rug; Emily's room, Mueseum
Carpenter's Mat; Carpenter's
Sword Rug; Sebastian's Room
Theater Rug; Movie Theater (not Joja)
Joja Theater Rug; Movie Theater (Joja)
Brown Square Rug; Marnie's room, Pierre's shop, Clint's shop, Pam's upgraded room
Woven Mat; Community Center fish tank
Yellow Cottage Rug; Carpenter's, Marnie's
[/spoiler]

I'm sure I missed a few, so if there's any specific ones you'd like added, let me know and I can try adding them too.
